title: [PLACEHOLDER] The Line Between Hacker and Criminal
prompt: [PLACEHOLDER] Think of a skill that can be used for both good and harmful purposes — cooking, driving, chemistry, or picking a lock. What is the single thing that separates the professional using that skill legally from the person using it criminally?
context: [PLACEHOLDER] This reflection sets up the core principle of the entire VAPT course: the distinction between ethical and malicious hacking is not technical — it is legal and ethical. Both use identical skills and tools.
guideQuestions: [PLACEHOLDER] What role does authorisation play in making a skill or action legitimate?
[PLACEHOLDER] Can you think of a real-world example where the same technical knowledge led to very different legal outcomes?
[PLACEHOLDER] What responsibility does a professional have when they discover something dangerous while using their skills legally?
